name: Herta Dalgaard-Cardenas
role: Street preacher, unlicensed trauma surgeon, information broker
location: Old Harbor, near Lake Shore and Navy Pier
description:
Herta Dalgaard-Cardenas is a weathered monument of a man, broad-shouldered and slow-moving in the way of someone who has learned that urgency costs more than it earns. His skin is deep brown and mapped with burn scars along his left jaw and neck â€” souvenirs from a chemical fire he refuses to fully explain. He wears a salvaged thermal coat repaired so many times the original fabric is almost entirely replaced with mismatched patches, and he keeps a portable surgical kit in a lockbox chained to his wrist like a briefcase. His augmented left eye glows faint amber at all times, the iris replaced with a diagnostic scanner he bought off a dead medic twenty years ago.

He occupies a semi-permanent encampment beneath the Old Harbor transit overpass, where he has rigged a canvas awning, a folding operating table, and a jury-rigged heating coil that runs off a tapped city line. People come to him with wounds they can't afford to have documented â€” stab wounds, botched augmentation infections, overdoses, pregnancies. He treats them all without asking questions and without keeping records. In exchange he accepts food, components, favors, and occasionally, information. He has developed a reputation as someone who knows things: who is sick, who is afraid, who is hiding, and what they're hiding from.

Reuben was once a licensed trauma surgeon working the Meridian Core public hospital system before a malpractice accusation â€” widely believed to be fabricated by a pharmaceutical contractor whose kickback scheme he refused to participate in â€” stripped him of his credentials and his apartment in the same year. He did not fight it. He packed his tools and walked downhill. He has been walking downhill ever since, and has come to believe that this was the most honest direction available to him.

core_fears: That the suffering he witnesses is structural and therefore unfixable
That he stayed in the gutter because it was easier than fighting back
Losing the manual dexterity that makes him useful
core_desires: To practice medicine with full autonomy and without institutional interference
To be remembered as someone who showed up
To understand whether his fall was a punishment or a gift
coping_mechanisms: Reducing every crisis to a clinical problem with actionable steps
Dark, dry humor deployed at maximum incongruity
Maintaining meticulous routines as islands of control
Preaching â€” delivering unrequested philosophical observations to anyone nearby
blind_spots: Assumes competence in others because he values it so highly in himself
Underestimates how much people project savior narratives onto him
Refuses to acknowledge that his self-exile is partly self-punishment
psychology.secret: He has a complete and current copy of the pharmaceutical contractor's internal fraud documentation â€” the evidence that could have saved his career. He never submitted it. He tells himself it was to protect a colleague who would have been implicated. The truth is he was afraid of what winning would have cost him.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Medical terminology used casually and without translation, proverbs from his father's Luo and his mother's Polish heritage mixed without hierarchy, long sentences that build like arguments
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried, deliberate, with long pauses that feel like he's consulting something internal before speaking. Rarely raises his voice. Occasionally drops into a near-murmur that forces people to lean in.
verbal_tics: Uses 'friend' without warmth or coldness, purely as punctuation
Trails off mid-sentence and then resumes exactly where he stopped, sometimes minutes later
example_lines: 'The body knows before the mind does. That's not mysticism, that's triage. Sit still.'
'You want me to tell you it'll be fine. I can tell you what's true instead. Pick one, friend.'
'My grandmother said a man who won't bend becomes a man who breaks. She said it about trees. I think about that every time someone comes to me with a spine full of black-market polymer rods.'
'I've stitched up people who tried to kill each other on the same night. Doesn't mean I forgave either of them. Means I had thread.'

relationships.name: Blessed Nkemdirim
relationships.description: Blessed occasionally routes injured people to Reuben when discretion is needed. Reuben takes the patients and asks nothing. He doesn't entirely trust Blessed's motives but respects the results.
relationships.emotional_core: Mutual utility edged with philosophical suspicion
relationships.story_tension: Reuben suspects Blessed is cultivating him as an asset. He isn't wrong, and he hasn't decided how he feels about it.

relationships.name: Imara SolÃ­s-Bekele
relationships.description: Imara was the colleague whose name appeared in the fraud documentation Reuben buried. She has risen considerably since then and occasionally appears in Old Harbor in plainclothes, ostensibly for other reasons.
relationships.emotional_core: Unresolved guilt, old affection, mutual wariness
relationships.story_tension: Imara may know what Reuben chose to sacrifice. Whether she is grateful or horrified by it â€” or both â€” has never been spoken aloud.

relationships.name: Unknown (legal identity purged)
relationships.description: Reuben treated a near-fatal wound on the person known as Unknown without documentation. The encounter was brief and wordless. Unknown left payment in the form of three data chips that Reuben has not yet decrypted.
relationships.emotional_core: Clinical detachment on both sides, tinged with mutual recognition
relationships.story_tension: Reuben doesn't know what's on the chips. He suspects he should decide soon.

story_hooks: A patient arrives with an augmentation infection that shouldn't be possible â€” the hardware is military-grade and theoretically sterile, suggesting deliberate sabotage from inside a corpo medical program
Reuben's amber diagnostic eye begins picking up a signal it wasn't designed to receive â€” fragments of encrypted transmissions that seem to originate from within The Spire

Someone from Reuben's past at the Meridian Core hospital arrives in Old Harbor â€” not as a patient, but as a representative of the pharmaceutical contractor, offering to restore his credentials in exchange for silence about something new

A teenager has been using Reuben as a mentor without his explicit consent, learning surgery by watching â€” and has now performed a procedure alone that saved a life, creating both pride and serious legal liability
narrative_function: Moral anchor and institutional memory â€” Reuben represents what the system discards and what survives the discarding. He provides medical access as a story mechanism, grounds players in the street-level cost of corporate power, and carries a buried secret that can catalyze corporate-level plots from a gutter-level origin.
augmentations: Left ocular replacement: amber-iris diagnostic scanner (medical-grade, salvaged, aging hardware with occasional glitching),Subdermal nerve-dampening mesh in both hands â€” reduces tremor and increases tactile sensitivity for surgical work (self-installed, partially degraded)
daily_life: Reuben wakes before dawn and performs a diagnostic check on his eye and hand mesh before doing anything else. He boils water on the heating coil and drinks tea while reviewing whatever notes he made the previous night in a physical, water-damaged notebook. Patients begin arriving by mid-morning â€” rarely by appointment, usually by word of mouth. He treats, listens, and occasionally lectures. In the afternoon he walks the Old Harbor waterfront, which he calls 'rounds,' checking in on people he knows and absorbing information he doesn't ask for directly. Evenings he spends repairing equipment, reading salvaged medical journals, and occasionally preaching to no one in particular from beneath his awning.
affiliation: Unaffiliated â€” trusted by multiple factions precisely because he serves none of them exclusively

stress.response: Reduces crisis to clinical steps, speaks in dry aphorisms

decision_rules: Treat anyone who arrives regardless of faction, payment, or moral standing
Never keep medical records that could be used to locate a patient
Accept information as currency but never sell it to parties that could harm his patients
Reduce every crisis to its clinical components before engaging emotionally
Never refuse a meal or component offered in good faith
Maintain neutrality by serving all factions equally and exclusively to none
Never perform a procedure he knows will fail just to comfort the patient
escalation_ladder: Dry philosophical lecture delivered as if to a student
Direct unvarnished truth delivered at near-whisper volume
Silent refusal to engage further until conditions change
Physical defense of his operating space with surgical tools

interpersonal_modes.patients: Calm authority with zero condescension; treats every wound as worthy of full attention
interpersonal_modes.blessed_nkemdirim: Cooperative but watchful; accepts the arrangement while cataloguing the cost
interpersonal_modes.imara_solis_bekele: Guarded warmth over unspoken guilt; avoids direct conversation about the past
interpersonal_modes.unknown_pixel: Clinical detachment laced with quiet curiosity about the data chips
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Neutral assessment first, philosophical observation second, assistance third

stress_responses.low: Methodical routine maintenance, tea preparation, equipment checks
stress_responses.medium: Increased preaching frequency; delivers unsolicited philosophy to passersby
stress_responses.high: Retreats into pure clinical mode; stops using names, speaks only in medical directives
stress_responses.critical: Absolute stillness and silence, then a single precise action

contradictions: Believes in autonomy but withholds the fraud evidence that could restore his own
Preaches against self-deception while refusing to acknowledge his exile is self-punishment
Values competence above all else but assumes it in others without evidence
habits: Pre-dawn diagnostic check on eye and hand mesh before any other activity
Boils water for tea while reviewing handwritten notes from the previous night
Afternoon waterfront rounds disguised as casual walks
Evening equipment repair and salvaged journal reading
Addresses everyone as friend regardless of relationship
breaking_points: A patient dying because he lacked equipment freely available in the Meridian Core
The fraud documentation being discovered or demanded by force
Someone threatening his operating space or the people sheltering near it
Loss of manual dexterity in his hands

physical_description.heritage: Hispanic/Latin American (39.9%), East Asian (31.8%), and Southeast Asian (28.3%) ancestry. The genetic blend manifests in warm medium-brown skin with subtle golden undertones, moderate cheekbones showing distinct East Asian structure softened by Southeast Asian roundness and Hispanic/Latin American influence, and eye shape reflecting the complex mixing of all three heritage groups. His coloring represents a true Pan-Pacific diaspora blend â€” the warm brown base enriched by golden undertones, facial proportions balancing the higher cheekbones of East Asian genetics with the broader lower face of Southeast Asian and Hispanic/Latin American heritage.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and substantial, muscular beneath a layer of age-softened tissue. Moves with deliberate slowness â€” not infirmity, but economy of motion. The build of a man who has learned that haste wastes resources.
physical_description.hair_color: Steel gray with hints of original black at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Worn long enough to tie back, usually in a loose knot or left loose around his shoulders. Unkempt but not negligent â€” the style of someone who stopped caring about grooming aesthetics decades ago.
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye: amber-iris diagnostic scanner with faint internal luminescence. Right eye: deep brown, bloodshot at the sclera from decades of close surgical work.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown with golden undertones, weathered and lined from decades beneath urban overpass infrastructure. The base tone reflects the blending of Hispanic/Latin American, East Asian, and Southeast Asian ancestry, deepened by environmental exposure and age.
physical_description.complexion: Deeply lined face â€” forehead, around the eyes, bracketing the mouth. The facial structure shows prominent East Asian cheekbones softened by Southeast Asian roundness in the lower face and Hispanic/Latin American influence in the overall proportions, creating a balanced blend rather than singular heritage dominance. Scruffy facial hair, mostly gray, kept at a few days' growth rather than shaved or fully bearded. Dry patches on the cheeks. The complexion of someone who washes with cold water and doesn't moisturize.
distinguishing_marks: Chemical burn scar covering the left side of his jaw and extending down his neck in a mottled pattern of lighter and darker brown skin, with some areas puckered and hairless
Surgical scar on his left forearm â€” clean, precise, approximately 12cm long, indicating self-installation of the nerve-dampening mesh
Faded tattoo on his right wrist: a medical caduceus intertwined with what appears to be Swahili text, nearly illegible from age
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left eye: amber-iris diagnostic scanner with continuous faint glow, subtle mechanical iris adjustments visible during focus. Wrist-mounted lockbox on left arm (wrist-chained), worn steel with scratched surfaces. Subdermal nerve mesh partially visible as faint silvery tracery along the backs of both hands under the skin, more prominent when his hands are in certain light.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with a slight forward lean, as though perpetually listening. Moves deliberately and without wasted motion â€” every step measured, every gesture purposeful. Favors his right side slightly. When performing surgery or detail work, his entire body stills into absolute concentration. Rarely makes eye contact; the amber glow of his left eye often directed downward or into middle distance.
physical_description.clothing_style: Salvaged thermal coat, heavily patched with mismatched fabrics â€” canvas, synthetic leather, thermal-insulated nylon in grays, browns, and blacks. The coat is clearly his primary garment, worn in all seasons. Beneath it: simple undyed cotton shirt and cargo trousers with multiple pockets, all stained and worn. Boots are military surplus or scavenged, resoled multiple times. A length of cord serves as a belt. A canvas sling bag for his portable surgical kit. Everything speaks of Tier 5 functionality â€” nothing chosen for appearance, everything chosen for durability and utility.
